rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an orbiting body, including a man-made one when the context is clear.

example.english: The satellite will pass over Hong Kong tonight.
example.traditional: 衛星今晚會掠過香港上空。
example.jyutping: wai6 sing1 gam1 maan5 wui5 loek6 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2 soeng6 hung1

rows.note: Use this when you need to specify that the satellite is artificial rather than a natural moon or body.

example.english: The satellite helps us collect weather data.
example.traditional: 人造衛星幫我哋收集天氣資料。
example.jyutping: jan4 zou6 wai6 sing1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 sau1 zaap6 tin1 hei3 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for television received through artificial satellites.

example.english: We’re watching satellite TV at home now.
example.traditional: 我屋企而家睇緊衛星電視。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 ji4 gaa1 tai2 gan2 wai6 sing1 din6 si6
